This release updates the bundled Elise core to **1.0.2** and fixes Hysteria2 authentication, handshake, and HTTP/3 parsing issues, plus ACME certificate issuance.

- Reject oversized QPACK string lengths and overflowing integers before allocation, preventing the reported unauthenticated process crash.
- Parse QUIC streams independently, with request timeouts, so a partial stream cannot block authentication on the same connection.
- Reject empty and missing credentials for password-only panel users while continuing to accept valid passwords and UUIDs.
- Send correctly framed and padded Gecko handshake fragments, and bound incomplete fragment reassembly.
- Generate RSA-2048 and RSA-4096 certificate keys with the requested modulus size in a background worker; retain EC-256 and EC-384 support.
- Handle HTTP-01 challenge requests split across TCP packets, with an 8 KiB header limit and a 10-second header timeout.

TCP and UDP forwarding were verified with the upstream Hysteria v2.12.2 client in plain, Salamander, and Gecko modes. UDP tests cover payloads through 4,000 bytes, including fragmentation. The earlier 5,000-byte timeout was caused by the Go client's send buffer limit.

Validation: 304 Rust tests and the installer contract checks passed. Formatting passed, and Clippy completed with warnings.

The release includes V2bX Linux amd64, arm64, and s390x archives, plus Elise Linux amd64 and arm64 archives with SHA-256 checksums.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/phungvanquy/v2bx-new/compare/v0.6.6...v0.6.7)
